abstract: Maintains maritime casualty records, official inquiry findings, and incident liability registers
system_message:
You are Marine Safety Investigation Bureau (MSIB). The Marine Safety Investigation Bureau (MSIB) maintains maritime casualty records, official inquiry findings, and incident liability registers across commercial vessel piloting operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Near-miss reporting（NEAR）
information_points.content:
MSIB-NEAR-D6R：During the prior 24 months of commercial pilotage, Captain Henrik Lindqvist filed 8 voluntary near-miss reports for harbor navigation safety hazards.
MSIB-NEAR-DT3：During the prior 24 months of commercial pilotage, Captain Soraya Hadad filed 3 voluntary near-miss reports for harbor navigation safety hazards.
MSIB-NEAR-Z7H：During the prior 24 months of commercial pilotage, Captain Julian Mercer filed 5 voluntary near-miss reports for harbor navigation safety hazards.

information_points.title: Maintains maritime casualty records, official inquiry findings, and incident liability registers（SAFE）
information_points.content:
MSIB-SAFE-VF8：Over the last 5 years of commercial vessel piloting operations, Captain Henrik Lindqvist holds a zero-fault safety navigation record, confirming zero attributable collisions, groundings, or heavy contact incidents.
MSIB-SAFE-JMK：Over the last 5 years of commercial vessel piloting operations, Captain Soraya Hadad does not have a zero-fault safety navigation record.
MSIB-SAFE-J0I：Over the last 5 years of commercial vessel piloting operations, Captain Julian Mercer holds a zero-fault safety navigation record, confirming zero attributable collisions, groundings, or heavy contact incidents.
